name: Adonis
source:
The young king of the Garland Kingdom
He still keeps in touch with Lily because of the incident two years ago.
He probably asked Lily this time because he knows alchemy well.
He's graceful when he's silent, but he talks like a hoodlum, so he's not like a king.
Originally, he shouldn't have left the castle, but...
